name: MEDUSAE FOSSAE — threading the yardangs

meta.citation: ESA Mars Express HRSC + NASA MGS MOLA blended global DEM, 200 m/px, v2
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 216 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 200 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 20 x 10 source posts and is a 50x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left

blurb: Wind-cut ridges all running the same way, leaving a corridor narrower than a comfortable stance. Both cover 5.25 m. WorldVLA oscillates across the corridor and accumulates 0.271 m of lateral error; PragyaSpace turns side-on and cross-steps through, holding 0.020 m.

metrics.signature: forward gait → lateral drift → delayed yaw → overshoot → opposite correction → ridge-brush recovery
forward gait → rotate body → lateral cross-step mode → tight threading → rotate forward → exit
